title: Web3 Tooling Series with CARBON Copy
summary: A three-part research series by the Greenpill Writers Guild and CARBON Copy on how ReFi communities use Web3 tools.
description: Understanding Web3 Tooling Challenges for ReFi Communities, a joint initiative by CARBON Copy and the Greenpill Network Writers Guild, draws on interviews, surveys and case studies. Its three parts cover the data, the experience and recommendations, published from January 26 to February 9, 2026.
author: Greenpill Writers Guild
